mechanism.claim: After a large completed three-hour BTC move, a further same-direction but smaller completed hour while both BVOL and DVOL contract indicates implied-risk normalization without price rejection; the established direction should relay for six hours.
mechanism.side: sign of the completed preceding three-hour BTC return
mechanism.why_distinct: JVCTR requires same-direction price deceleration and joint cross-venue volatility contraction across separate completed hours. HVTPR required an opposite pullback under high volatility levels; prior shock-deceleration candidates used within-hour halves and opposing volatility bodies or traded reversal.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: joint options-volatility cooling after multi-hour directional discovery is absent from Gross9

clock.decision: completed UTC hour D after four consecutive valid price and volatility hours
clock.trend: nonzero return over the three hours immediately before the current hour; absolute value >= strict-prior 720h q60 with 672 observations
clock.price_deceleration: current completed-hour return is nonzero, same sign as trend, and absolute magnitude <=0.5 times absolute trend
clock.volatility_cooling: normalized BVOL and DVOL current-hour bodies are both strictly negative
clock.trigger: false-to-true onset on exact consecutive hourly grid
clock.reservation: global half-open, exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only for later PnL

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR
